name: Liam Baker
bio:
Liam's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood spent around his grandfather's garage, a local mechanic who moonlighted as a weekend racer. Immersed in the world of engines and speed, Liam pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. Recognizing his knack for understanding and translating driver feedback into tangible technical improvements, he transitioned into a test driver coordinator role.

As a coordinator, Liam thrives on bridging the gap between the engineering team and the drivers, ensuring clear communication and efficient testing schedules. He possesses a keen eye for detail and a methodical approach to data analysis, extracting crucial insights from track sessions. His ambition drives him to constantly seek innovative solutions to optimize testing processes and maximize the team's performance.

What sets Liam apart is his inherent ability to mentor junior engineers and drivers, fostering a collaborative environment where knowledge is freely shared. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, always willing to go the extra mile to achieve collective success. Liam's combination of technical acumen, management skills, and team spirit makes him a valuable asset to any motorsport organization.
